summary: Iteration 4: Validated Daily Challenge backend endpoint, 6 AI-generated portraits, accessibility settings drawer, partner picker, and /daily UI flow. Added 2 new backend tests (TestDailyChallenge) — 27/27 backend pytest pass. Frontend critical UI verified end-to-end.

issues: Radix DialogContent console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'. Accessibility nit — add a <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby={undefined} suppression.

The 'Daily Challenge' button is the 5th primary action and wraps to a second row at 1920px because the 4 primary buttons + Daily are laid out in a single flex group. Cosmetic — looks intentional in the screenshot but worth noting if the design called for balanced rows.

action_items: (Optional / a11y) Add DialogDescription to SettingsDrawer's DialogContent to silence the Radix aria warning.

(Optional) Verify co-op partner bonus end-to-end manually: with character=chris, partner=arthur on /play/1, the correct-answer toast description should include both 'Chris's specialty +10' and 'Partner arthur coach +5'. Code path in GamePlay.jsx (lines 100-131) is correct by inspection but Playwright was unable to drive the hotspot→puzzle transition reliably due to dynamic hotspot data-testids.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/daily-challenge: deterministic sha256-based seeding per (date, character) is correct and idempotent within a UTC day; verified by two back-to-back calls returning identical puzzle ids.
server.py /api/daily-challenge: skips puzzles of type 'pattern' (good — they need sequence not options).
server.py /api/daily-challenge: response correctly strips the 'answer' field — verified by test_daily_challenge_shape.
gameStore.js: applyAccessibility() correctly adds/removes 'reduce-motion' and 'large-text' on documentElement; persistence verified via localStorage assertions.

GamePlay.jsx: co-op bonus stacking logic (lines 100-131) properly applies primary specialty (once/level), primary flat bonus (every correct), partner specialty (once/level if partner's specialty matches current level), and partner flat bonus (every correct). Math for chris+arthur on level 1 medium puzzle = 20 + 10 + 5 = 35 ✓.
DailyChallenge.jsx avatar src uses /portraits/{character_id}.png — matches files in /app/frontend/public/portraits/.
Settings drawer disables the current character in the partner picker — verified: partner-pick-chris is disabled when localStorage character=chris.
Note (pre-existing, not introduced this iter): /api/ai/riddle stores generated puzzles only in in-memory _PUZZLE_CACHE — will be lost on backend restart.

success_rate.frontend: 95% — co-op end-to-end toast not auto-captured but code path verified by inspection

test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests auto-create TEST_ prefixed player IDs and clean up via session fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has 26 /api endpoints. Daily endpoint at GET /api/daily-challenge returns {date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', challenges: [{character_id, puzzle:{id,type,category,question,options}}]} — one per character (chris/archie/lynn/deb/dolly/arthur). All 27 pytest tests pass in ~8.6s. Frontend verified: 5 main-menu buttons including open-daily-button, 6 portraits (1024x1024 PNGs all complete=true), nav-settings-button→settings-drawer with toggle-reduce-motion, toggle-large-text, and partner-pick-{id} (current character disabled), /daily page renders daily-challenge-page with active character avatar (chris.png shown first). Reduce-motion and large-text toggles add 'reduce-motion'/'large-text' classes to <html> AND persist to localStorage keys 'strayz_reduce_motion'/'strayz_large_text'. Pre-existing AudioContext autoplay warnings are expected browser behavior — not a bug. Only minor a11y warning: Radix DialogContent missing DialogDescription.
rca of the issue: No bug found. Only minor a11y console warning (DialogContent description missing) and an automation-only limitation around driving the hotspot→puzzle transition for the co-op bonus end-to-end check; underlying code is correct.
